s.note: Fozzie bombs at the El Sleezo. Hot cheddar nachos.
s.how: Warm the beans with the cumin and a splash of water, mashing a few. Mix the tomato and onion with half the lime juice and a pinch of salt. Layer the chips, beans and cheese twice in a baking dish and bake at 200C until the cheese bubbles. Mash the avocado with the rest of the lime and top the nachos with salsa, avocado and sour cream.

s.note: Piggy wins the pageant. Honey butter corn.
s.how: Mash the butter with the honey, chilli and a pinch of salt. Boil the corn for 4 minutes, then drain. Grill or pan-char the cobs, turning, until spotted brown all over. Brush with the honey butter, scatter with parmesan and serve with lime.

m.note: Kermit turns Hopper down. Buttermilk chicken.
m.how: Soak the drumsticks in the buttermilk with a big pinch of salt for at least an hour. Mix the flour with the paprika, garlic powder and salt, and dredge the drumsticks well. Fry in oil at 160C in batches, turning, until deep golden and cooked through. Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayo and vinegar. Drain the chicken and serve with the slaw and hot sauce.

m.note: Stuck at a desert campfire. Smoky beef chilli.
m.how: Brown the mince in batches, then soften the onion and garlic in the same pan. Stir in the spices, tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer gently, stirring now and then. Whisk the polenta, flour, milk, eggs, butter and a pinch of salt into a batter. Pour into a hot greased skillet and bake at 200C until golden and springy. Serve the chilli in bowls with wedges of cornbread.

w.note: Kermit's banjo in the swamp. Hot fudge sundaes.
w.how: Heat the cream and golden syrup, pour over the chocolate and stir until glossy. Scoop the ice cream into 4 tall glasses with the strawberries and banana. Pour over the warm fudge sauce, shower with sprinkles and top each with a cherry.

d.note: The waiter's Idaho fizz. Frozen grapes on ice.
d.how: Drop a few frozen grapes into 4 chilled glasses. Fill two thirds with the grape juice, top with soda and add a twist of lemon.
